about_the_game:
Thunder Tiger is a fast-paced, side-scrolling shoot ’em up that blends the timeless charm of 1980s and 1990s arcades with a fresh, futuristic twist. Command your sleek, heavily armed fighter through a series of intense 2D stages teeming with alien threats, mechanized war machines, and heart-pounding boss battles. With its vibrant pixel graphics and nostalgic retro flair, Thunder Tiger offers a thrilling old-school shooter experience tailored for modern players.

Blast your way through linear, action-packed levels, perfect for unleashing your reflexes and competing for new high scores. Each stage is designed for relentless arcade mayhem, complete with rapid-fire power-ups and mesmerizing visual effects. Whether you’re a longtime fan of classic shooters or new to the genre, Thunder Tiger’s tight controls and smooth controller support make it easy to pick up, but challenging to master.

In Thunder Tiger, every second counts—dodge and weave through waves of enemies, collect power-ups to upgrade your firepower, and chain kills to rack up massive combos. Are you ready to relive the golden era of arcade action with modern speed and style? Climb into the cockpit and prepare to save the galaxy—Thunder Tiger is calling your name!
